Case Study: Anonymised — Commercial Solar Operator

How AICORE helped a Energy & Utilities client: A commercial solar installation company managing systems across 30+ client sites had no centralised visibility into how each installation was performi...

Challenge: A commercial solar installation company managing systems across 30+ client sites had no centralised visibility into how each installation was performing. Performance issues — degraded panels, failing inverters, battery problems — were only discovered when clients reported power outages. By that point, damage had already occurred and the company's reputation suffered. Remote monitoring existed on some systems but was fragmented across three incompatible manufacturer apps.

Solution: AICORE built a unified Smart Energy Monitoring platform that connected to all 30 client sites via existing inverter communication interfaces and supplementary current sensors where needed. All site data flows into a single dashboard, giving the operator real-time performance visibility across the entire portfolio. Automated alerts fire when a site's Performance Ratio drops below threshold or when battery SoH indicators flag a unit for inspection. Client-facing reports are generated automatically each month.

Outcomes: Portfolio-wide performance visibility achieved for the first time Average fault detection time reduced from client report (days) to automated alert (minutes) Proactive maintenance dispatches increased by 200% in the first quarter Client satisfaction score improved from 72% to 91% at 6-month review

Technologies: MQTT, Modbus, InfluxDB, React dashboard, Python, SMS/Email alerting.
